question: Do the ClawHub trust, Gateway Skills, and Android owners approve `skills.securityReview` as the permanent `operator.admin` pre-install contract for native clients?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and well-proven, but automated review cannot choose a durable cross-client security API or its long-term ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the dedicated RPC
options.body: Keep the exact-release method after rebasing, regenerating shared protocol outputs, and confirming the exact final head preserves the proven trust outcomes.

options.title: Fold review into installation
options.body: Replace the separate preflight call with a server-issued review token or canonical server-owned review-and-install operation.

options.title: Defer Android installation
options.body: Land installed-skill search, filtering, status, and global toggles while postponing native ClawHub installation.

recommendation.title: Approve the dedicated RPC
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-release method after rebasing, regenerating shared protocol outputs, and confirming the exact final head preserves the proven trust outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently reviewed, repaired, and merged the closest Android admin-control feature on the same runtime surface and are the strongest observed owner for the mobile product/security decision.
